inputs.text: They're pushing this bogus tale that 8 million Americans turned out for these "No Kings" protests against President Donald Trump at more than 3,300 events across all 50 states. The organizers are hyping it as a million more people and 600 extra events than their October round, and AFP is just repeating the figures like they're solid. Yet the US authorities released zero official count whatsoever. This is the hidden elites and institutions coordinating behind the scenes to fabricate the illusion of massive resistance and protect their grip on everything. The total absence of any real verification exposes it as another manufactured narrative designed to weaken his position, not some authentic uprising.
